spans.s:
(घ) r. 2d cl. (अनिति) Also of 4th cl. (ङ) (अन्यते)
To breathe, to live See अण.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Eaten.
n. (-न्नं)
1 Boiled rice.
2 Food in general.
3 Corn.
E.
अद to eat, and क्त affix of the part. past. त becoming न.

m. (-नः)
Breath inspired.
E.
अन् to be, अण् affix; existing by it.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्नी-न्नं)
1 Fed, having food.
2 Relating to food, derived from it, &c.
E.
अन्न and अण् aff.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Portionless, not entitled to a share or portion.
E.
अन neg. अंश a part.

f. (-ला)
A plantain, (Musa sapientum.) See अंशुमत्फला.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Inferior, low. See अणक.

m. (-कः)
1 A large military drum, beaten at one end.
2 A double drum.
3 A small drum or tabor.
4 A thunder-cloud. or a cloud to which the noise of the thunder is ascribed.
E.
आङ्, अन to sound, and वुन् aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-का-क्षं)
Blind, eyeless.
E.
अन् neg. अक्षि the eye, the final dropped.

n. (-र)
1 Blamable discourse, what is unfit to be uttered.
2 Abuse.
E.
अन् neg. and अक्षर a letter.

mfn. (-क्षिः-क्षिः-क्षि)
Having bad eyes.
E.
अन् neg. and अक्षि the eye.

m. (-रः)
A saint, an anchorite.
E.
अन् neg. and अगार a house; living in woods.

m. (-ग्निः)
A Brahman who has not maintained his household fire.
E.
अन् neg. अग्नि fire.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
1 Clean, clear.
2 Pure, sinless.
2 Handsome, pleasing.
E.
अन् neg. and अघ fault, faultless.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Bodiless, incorporeal.
m. (-हृ)
A name of KĀMA, the Hindu deity of love.
n. (-ङ्गं)
1 Heaven, aether or the atmosphere.
2 The mind or faculty of reasoning.
E.
अन् neg. and अङ्ग body; as applicable to KĀMA, it alludes to his having been reduced to ashes, by the eye of ŚIVA, for having disturbed his devotions, and rendered him enamoured of PĀRVATĪ.

n. (-कं)
The mind or faculty of reasoning.
E.
अनङ्ग, and कन् aff.

m. (-हृद or -हृत्)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
अनङ्ग KĀMA, अ neg. and सुहृद् a friend, the foe of KĀMA.

mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं)
Turbid, muddy.
E.
अन् neg. and अच्छ clear.

n. (-नं)
The sky, atmosphere, aether.
E.
अञ्ज to go, with the neg. prefix अन्, and affix ल्युट्.

m. (-ड्वान्)
A bull or ox.
f. (-डुही or -ड्वाही)
A cow.
E.
अनस् a cart, वह to bear, and क्विप् affix, with ड inserted: after अनस्, व is changed to उ in the mas., optionally in the fem.

m. (-णुः)
Small grain.
E.
अन् neg. अणु an atom.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Erect, not bowed down.
2 Proud, haughty.
E.
अ neg. नत bowed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bending, stooping, bowed.
2 Pacified, conciliated.
3

Humbled.
4

Submissive, obedient.
E.
आङ् before नम to bow or bend, affix क्त.

f. (-ता)
1 Erectness, stiffness.
2 Pride. also अनतत्व n. (-त्वं)
E.
ता or त्व added to the last.

m. (-मः)
1 Moderation, mediocrity, equality, not over. stepping certain limits, not surpassing certain qualities, &c.
2 Propriety, decorum.
E.
अन् neg. अतिक्रम exceeding.

ind.
Not having transgressed, &c.
mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्य)
Incapable of being transgressed or exceeded.
E.
अन् neg. अतिक्रम्य having surpassed, &c.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Unsurpassed, unexceeded.
2 Untransgressed, &c.
E.
अन् neg. अतिक्रान्त surpassed, &c.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Equal, not exceeded in quantity or quality.
E.
अन् neg. आंतक्त more.

m. (-रः)
Absence of right, claim, interest or concern.
E.
अन् neg. अधिकार right.

f. (-र्च्चा)
Officiousness, meddling with other people's business.
E.
अनधिकार, and चर्च्चा investigation.

m. (-री)
A non-heir, one who has no right or claim.
E.
अन् neg. अधिकारिन् an heir.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Uninherited, unclaimed.
2 Not set over, or appointed.
E.
अन् neg. अधिकृत claimed, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Not acquired.
2 Not learnt or studied.
E.
अन् neg. अधिगत gone over.

m. (-मः)
1 Non-acquirement.
2 Non-perusal.
E.
अन् neg. अधिगम obtaining, &c.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
1

Unattainable.
2

Incapable of being known.
E.
अन् neg. अधिगम्य to be attained.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Absent, not present.
2 Not placed over, not appointed.
3 Not ordered or enjoined.
E.
अन् neg. अधिष्ठित placed over.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Independent.
E.
अन् neg. अधीन dependant.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Imperceptible, unperceived, absent. See अप्रत्यक्ष.
2 Having no superintendent.
E.
अन् neg. and अध्यक्ष perceptible, &c.

m. (-यः)
Intermission of study.
E.
अन् neg. अध्याय reading.

m. (-सः)
A day on which it is improper to study.
E.
अनध्याय, and दिबस a day.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Denied, refused, not assented to.
E.
अन् neg. अनुज्ञात assented to.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Eternal, endless.
2 Unbounded, illimitable.
3 Infinite, innumerable.
m. (-न्तः)
1 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆ
BALADEVA, the brother of KṚṢṆ
The chief of the Nāgas or serpent race, that inhabit the infernal regions: the couch and constant attendant of VIṢṆ

The king of serpents, confounded with VĀSUKI. See वासुकि.
5 The fourteenth of the Jaina Tīrthakaras or deified Saints: also called अनन्तजित्.
f. (-न्ता)
1 A name of PĀRVATĪ, the wife of Ś

IVA.
2

The earth.
3 A synonym of several plants, (as Hedysarum alhagi.)
4 A kind of potherb. See विशल्या.
5 Bent grass, (Agrostis linearis.)
6 Another plant, (Echites frutescens, Rox.) See श्यामा. Or according to others, (Asclepias psoudosarsa, Rox.) See शारीवा.
7 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia citrina.)
9 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.)
9 Another plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) See गुडुची.
10 Long pepper. See कणा.
n. (-न्तं)
Sky or atmosphere, aether.
E.
अन् neg. and अन्त end.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Endless, eternal.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-शी)
The fourteenth lunation of the light half of Bhadra, when ANANTA is worshipped.
E.
अनन्त, and चतुर्दशी the fourteenth.

m. (-जित्)
The fourteenth of the twenty-four Jaina deified Saints: also called अनन्त.
E.
अनन्त endless, and जित् who conquers, who gains eternity.

f. (-ता)
Eternity: also अनन्तत्व n. (-त्वं)
E.
ता or त्व added to अनन्त.

m. (-कृत्)
The fourteenth Jaina Saint, also अनन्त, &c.
E.
अनन्त endless, तीर्थ pilgrimage or virtue, and कृत् who has made.

m. (-लः)
A plant, (Periploca Indica.)
E.
अनन्त, and मूल root.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Next, immediately following.
2 Next of kin or in succession.
3 Close, compact.
n. (-रं)
Extreme propinquity.
E.
अन् neg. and अन्तर between; having nothing intermediate.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born of the next in order; as of a Kṣatriya woman, by a Brahman; of a Vaiśya woman, by a Kṣatriya.
E.
अनन्तर, and ज born.

f. (-शिः)
In arithmetic; infinite quantity.
E.
अनन्त endless, राशि quantity.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Multiform.
E.
अनन्त, and रूप form.

m. (-तः)
Rigidity or paralysis of the muscles of the face and neck.
E.
अनन्त, and वात wind.

m. (-यः)
The shell of YUDHIṢṬHIRA.
E.
अनन्त, and बिजय victory.

m. (-र्य्यः)
The twenty third Jaina Tīrthakara of a future age.
E.
अनन्त endless, and वीर्य्य power.

n. (-तं)
A ceremony performed in honour of VIṢṆU, on the day of the full moon in Bhādra.
E.
अनन्त, and व्रत a religious observance.

f. (-र्षा)
The wife of VĀSUKI, the king of serpents.
E.
अनन्त many, and शीर्ष a head; many headed.

mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं)
Infinite, unbounded, eternal.
n. (-त्य)
1

Immortality.
2

Eternity.
3

Infinity.
E.
अन् neg. अन्त्य final.

Infinity.
2

Immortality, future happiness.
E.
अनन्त endless, यञ् aff.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
1 One, sole, without any other.
2 Same, identical.
E.
अन् neg. अन्य other.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Having but one refuge.
f. (-तिः)
One only refuge or asylum.
E.
अनन्य, and गति motion.

mfn. (कः-का-कं)
Having one refuge or hope alone.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-जः)
A name of KĀMA or love.
E.
अन् neg. अन्य. other, and ज born; produced only in the heart.

Singleness.
2

Identity.
E.
अनन्य, and ता or त्व affix; also अनन्यत्वं.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
Intact, virgin, never in the prior possession of another.
f. (-र्व्वा)
A virgin, a girl not previously wedded.
E.
अन् neg. अन्य another, पूर्व्व prior; also with कन् added अनन्यपूर्ष्वक.

mfn. (वः-वा-वं)
Produced or effected by one particular person or thing.
E.
अनन्य, and भव born.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
See the next.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Intent, attentive, having the mind fixed on one subject, not absent.
E.
अन् neg. अन्यमनस् or अन्यसनस्क thinking of some thing else.

mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
Closely attentive, having the mind fixed on one object.
E.
अन् neg. अन्य other, वृत्ति profession.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Not stolen or taken, safe.
E.
अन् neg. अन्य another, हृत taken.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Incapable of being taken or stolen.
E.
अन् neg. अन्य another, हार्य्य to be taken.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unconnected with, irrelevant.
2 Devoid of, not possessing.
E.
अन् neg. अन्वित possessed of.

n. (-णं)
1 Non-requital, not retaliating.
2 Non-resumption.
3 Not doing ill.
E.
अन् before अपकरण evil doing.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 Non-retaliation.
2 Non-resumption, (of a thing given or paid, &c.)
3 Abstaining from evil.
E.
अन् before अपकर्म्म; also अनपाकर्म्म, अनपक्रिया, &c.

m. (-रः)
Harmlessness, freedom from hatred and malice.
E.
अन् neg. अपकार evil doing.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Innecuous.
E.
अनपकार, and इनि aff.

f. (-या)
1 Non-requital, non-retaliation.
2 Non-acquittance (as of debt, &c.)
3 Non-resumption.
4 Abstaining from offence or evil.
E.
अन् before अपक्रिया offence, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dishonoured, disregarded.
E.
अन् neg. अपचित honoured.

mfn. (-कः-त्या-त्यं)
Childless, having no progeny: so अनपत्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं).
E.
अन् neg. अपत्य offspring.

m. (-रः)
Name of BRAHMĀ.
E.
अन् neg. अपर another.

m. (-धः)
Innocence.
mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Innocent, sinless.
E.
अन् neg. अपराध offence.

mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि)
Innocent, sinless.
E.
अन् neg. अपराधिन् offending.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Undiminished, unceasing.
m. (-यः)
Permanence, absence of loss or diminution.
E.
अन् neg. अपाय loss.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Firm, constant, durable, imperishable.
2 Increasing.
E.
अनपाय permanence, इनि aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Disregarding, unheeding.
f. (क्षा)
Carelessness, indifference, disregard.
E.
अन neg. अपेक्षा regard.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unheeded, disregarded.
E.
अन् neg. अपेक्षित regarded.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Present, not passed or gone.
2 Possessed of, not devoid of.
E.
अन neg. अपेत gone away.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Disagreeable, unpleasant, disastrous, unlucky.
E.
अन् neg. अभिमत liked.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञ)
Unwise, stupid.
E.
अन् neg. अभिज्ञ wise.

m. (-वः)
Freedom from obstruction or defeat.
E.
अन् neg. अभिभव defeat.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unsubdued, unsurpassed.
2 Unobstructed.
E.
अन् neg. अभिभूत subdued.

m. (-षः)
Indifference, absence of desire.
E.
अन् neg. अभिलाष desire.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-वि)
Indifferent.
E.
अनभिलाष, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Indistinct, dim.
E.
अन् neg. अभिव्यक्त clear.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Detachment, disconnection, freedom from affection or attachment.
E.
अन् neg. अभिष्वङ्ग connection.

mfn. (-मः)
A Brahman, one who does not salute a Brahman, making obeisance to the gods only, and returning salutations with his blessing.
E.
अ neg. and नम who salutes.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Unworthy of being saluted.
E.
अ neg. नमस्य to be saluted.

Fate.
2

Ill-luck, bad-fortune.
3 Calamity, distress.
4 Vice, transgression.
E.
अन् neg. and अय good fortune.

Bringing.
2

Investiture with the sacred thread.
E.
आङ्, णीञ् to obtain, अच् aff.

m. (-यः)
A net.
E.
आङ् before णीञ् to obtain, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं)
To be brought.
m. (-य्यः)
Consecrated fire, taken from the household fire, and placed on the south side.
E.
आङ् before णी to obtain, ण्यत् affix: deriv. irregular.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fallen into misfortune.
E.
अनय, and गत gone.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Self-willed, unrestrained.
E.
अन् neg. and अर्गल a bolt or bar.

mfn. (-र्ध्यः-र्ध्या-र्ध्यं)
Invaluable, priceless, not to be bought.
E.
अन् neg. अर्य्य price.

n. (-त्वं)
Absence of price or cost, invaluableness; also अनर्ध्यता.
E.
त्व or ता added to the last.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unworshipped, unreverenced, disrespected.
E.
अन् neg. अर्च्चित worshipped.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
Unmeaning, fruitless, nonsensical.
E.
अन् neg. अर्थ use.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unmeaning, idle, fruitless.
n. (-कं)
Unmeaning or nonsensical discourse.
E.
अन् neg. अर्थ meaning, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Unfit, unworthy, unsuitable.
E.
अन् neg. अर्ह fit.

m. (-लः)
1 A name of AGNI or fire.
2 One of the eight Vasus or demigods^1 so called.
3

Bile.
4

A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica and rosea.)
E.
अन् to be, and कलच् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-या)
The wife of AGNI.
E.
अनल, and प्रिया beloved.

ind.
Insufficient, unequal, unable, not enough.
E.
अन् neg. अलम् enough.

m. (-लिः)
A plant, (Æschynomene grandiflora.) See अगस्तिद्रु.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Excellent, good, uncensured.
E.
अन् neg. अघगीत disparaged.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Resistless, not to be obstructed or impeded.
E.
अन् neg. अवग्रह obstruction.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 Blameless, irreproachable.
2 Unobjectionable, allowable.
E.
अन् neg. अवद्य censurable.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Careless, inattentive.
n. (-नं)
Inadvertence, inattention, carelessness.
E.
अन् neg. अवधान care.

f. (ता)
Inadvertence, inattention.
E.
ता affix, subjoined to the preceding; or with त्व, अनवधानत्वं.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Equal or superior, not younger nor inferior.
E.
अन् neg. अवर inferior.

adj. mfn. or adv. n. (-तः-ता-तं)
Eternal, eternally, continually.
E.
अन् neg. अवरत stopped, ceased.

mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं)
Chief, principal.
E.
अन् neg. अवरार्द्ध inferior.

mfn. (-म्वः-म्वा-म्वं)
Without support or dependance.
E.
अन् neg. अवलम्व support.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Occupied, busy, having no leisure.
2 Unseasonable, inopportune.
m. (-रः)
1 Want of leisure or opportunity.
2 Unseasonableness, inopportuneness.
E.
अन् neg. अवसर leisure.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Clean.
E.
अन् priv. and अवस्कर dirt.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Unstable, unsteady.
2 Incontinent.
f. (स्था)
1 Instability, absence of fixed state or condition. Uncertainty, doubt.
3 Incontinence, dissoluteness.
4 (In logic,) the abstract nature of a thing, independent of its existence.
E.
अम् neg. अवस्था condition.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Unsteady, mutable, variable, not stationary.
n. (-नं)
1

Instability.
2

Wrong situation or direction.
3 Misconduct.
m. (-नः)
Wind.
E.
अन् neg. अवस्थान fixture.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unfixed, unsteady, unstable, inconstant.
2 Loose, abandoned, violating moral and legal restraint.
E.
अन् neg. अवस्थित steady.

f. (-तिः)
1 Unsteadiness, instability.
2 Dissoluteness, profligacy.
E.
अन् neg. and अवस्थिति stability.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Unobtained.
E.
अन neg. अवाप्त obtained.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
One who fasts.
n. (-नं)
A fast, fasting.
E.
अन् neg. and अशन eating.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Eternal, imperishable.
E.
अ neg. and नश्वर transient.

n. (-नः)
1 A cart.
2 Boiled rice.
3 A mother.
4

Birth.
5

Life, breath.
